精灵族的修仙者最新章节_第342章 巢穴第1页_精灵族的修仙者左手打右脑_热点小说网
> 第342章 巢穴（第1页）
测试完雾隐的力量后，安东开始认真盘算起如何培育这个小家伙，好让它尽快成长起来。
培育一头神性生物，最根本的两样东西，无非是成长环境与食物。
前者不用多说，如果能让雾隐长期浸泡在与天性最为契合的环境中，引导其与天地共鸣，自行壮大，成长速度必然会大大提升。
“本来还想着来一场炫的，披着金甲圣衣，脚踩七彩祥云，从天而降，牛逼哄哄往那里一立，来上一句‘我来了’！”兰登瘫在椅子里做遐想状。
不过青玥不知道的是，幻兽的幻境对玄兽的效果不大，但对人族来说，效果却很明显。
我好像看见一只青色的孔雀，昂首阔步、姿态优雅地跟在他的身后。
入眼的便是一片坐在主位与副位的摄政王和太子，宣旨太监是域皇身前的红人，李长顺，人都尊称一声李总管。
而卧龙关的位置，与无尽深渊看起来颇为奇妙，高高的从上往下看来，就好像是一条神龙，从深渊中一跃而起一样，正所谓潜龙在渊，一飞冲天。
这一晚突然觉得爷爷变得非常的和蔼可亲，慈眉善目，她知道爷爷是怕她接受不了奶奶的生病离世，所以给自己说了一些看似坚强的话语，自己心里难过的要死，还有强装镇定的安慰哄我，爷爷太辛苦了。
这一看他才发现，不少人的肩膀上，都站着个宠物，各种各样的宠物都有，而且这些宠物与之前看到的野生宠物不同，它们头上的名字已经变成了“某某某的宠物某某某”。
帝君如何不知青玥是信不过他？无奈摇头道，“你的哥哥如今已经从苍苍山出来，身处皇宫之中，你的……爹爹在灵域，信或者不信，全凭你自己判断。”说罢，帝君便消失在青玥面前。
说到这里，张志平不由也有些紧张起来，毕竟元婴期修士的心思不好揣摩，谁知道他们心中是什么想法呢。
灰尘就在光线里飞舞，而没有光线的地方，却仿佛洁净的没有半点灰尘。
好像除了那件事情外，阿凤和福慧连见面都不曾呢，这千里迢迢的如果福慧说是来探望她的，可真就是天大的笑话了。
蕾莉不止一次的帮我带来新鲜血液，想劝我喝一点，我却只能每次都忍着想要作呕的感觉跟她说抱歉。
毕竟那些仙兽神兽都是从仙界之中跑出来的，可不是一般的灵兽能够相比的。
可惜的是，只要在宫中，谁的日子也不可能永远平静，冯太妃也不例外。
眼前的危机算是告一段落了。早在他刚刚进入洛阳城时，斥候便来报，李世民和李元吉率领唐军拔营撤离了，看来是知道洛阳城已经不可能拿下，所以放弃了这方面的努力。

但是谁也不能指出她的话是废话来，就算是江铭和阿凤心里再不赞同，也不会和皇后在这一点上起争执。
接连后退几步，她才敢看向江铭：其实如果可以不看最好，但是连看也不敢看就太弱了她宁国公主的身份。
“喂，李少爷吗，我是李朝举，有见事情告诉你，现在马家已经跟武家，高家，还有刘家联手，准备把李氏集团给吞了，好了我就说道这里，”李朝举说完，就挂断了。
听的娥凰直皱眉头，倒是铁瑛的脸‘色’没有什么变化，把玩着酒杯也不说一句话，仿佛已经神游在外，根本没有在听定侯二人在说什么。

The latest chapter of the Immortal Cultivator of the Elf Tribe_Chapter 342 Lair Page 1_The Immortal Cultivator of the Elf Tribe hits his right brain with his left hand_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 342 Lair (Page 1)
After testing Kirigakure's power, Anton began to seriously plan how to cultivate this little guy so that it could grow up as quickly as possible.
To cultivate a divine creature, the two most fundamental things are nothing more than the growth environment and food.
Needless to say about the former, if Kirigakure can be immersed in an environment that is most consistent with his nature for a long time, and guide him to resonate with the world and grow on his own, the growth rate will inevitably be greatly improved.
"I originally wanted to show off, wearing a golden armor and holy clothes, stepping on colorful auspicious clouds, falling from the sky, standing there and saying 'I'm here'!" Langdon slumped in his chair and dreamed.
But what Qing Yue doesn't know is that the fantasy beast's illusion has little effect on the mysterious beast, but the effect on the human race is very obvious.
I seemed to see a cyan peacock, following behind him with its head held high and gracefully.
What caught the eye was the regent and the prince sitting on the main and deputy seats. The eunuch announcing the decree was the famous person in front of the emperor, Li Changshun, who everyone respectfully called Mr. Li.
The location of Wolong Pass and the endless abyss look quite strange. From top to bottom, it looks like a divine dragon leaping up from the abyss. As the saying goes, the dragon lurks in the abyss and soars into the sky.
That night, she suddenly felt that her grandfather had become very amiable and kind-hearted. She knew that her grandfather was afraid that she would not be able to accept her grandmother's illness and death, so he said some seemingly strong words to herself.
At this glance, he discovered that many people had pets standing on their shoulders. There were all kinds of pets, and these pets were different from the wild pets he had seen before. The names on their heads had changed to "so-and-so's pet so-and-so".
How could the emperor not know that Qing Yue could not trust him? He shook his head helplessly and said, "Your brother has now come out of Cangcang Mountain and is in the palace. Your... father is in the spiritual realm. It's up to you to judge whether you believe it or not." After that, the emperor disappeared in front of Qing Yue.
Having said this, Zhang Zhiping couldn't help but become a little nervous. After all, it was difficult to figure out the thoughts of the Yuanying Stage monks. Who knew what they were thinking.
Dust is flying in the light, but the place without light seems to be clean without any dust.
It seems that apart from that incident, Ah Feng and Fu Hui have never even met each other. It would be a big joke if Fu Hui said that he came to visit her despite being so far apart.
Leili brought me fresh blood more than once and tried to persuade me to drink some, but I could only endure the feeling of nauseating and say sorry to her every time.
After all, those fairy beasts and beasts all ran away from the fairy world, and they were not comparable to ordinary spiritual beasts.
It is a pity that no one's life can be peaceful forever as long as they are in the palace, and Concubine Feng is no exception.
The current crisis is finally over. As early as when he entered Luoyang City, scouts came to report that Li Shimin and Li Yuanji led the Tang army to break camp and evacuate. It seems that they knew that Luoyang City was impossible to capture, so they gave up their efforts in this regard.
But no one can point out that her words are nonsense. Even if Jiang Ming and Afeng disagree in their hearts, they will not argue with the queen on this point.
After taking a few steps back, she dared to look at Jiang Ming: In fact, it would be best if she could not look at him, but if she didn't even dare to look at him, her status as the princess of Ningguo would be too weak.
"Hey, Master Li, I'm Li Chaoju. I'll tell you if I see something. Now the Ma family has joined forces with the Wu family, the Gao family, and the Liu family to swallow up the Li Group. Okay, I'll just say this," Li Chaoju said and hung up.
Ehuang frowned upon hearing this, but Tieying's faceThere was no change in his "color". He was playing with the wine glass without saying a word, as if his mind was already wandering away, not listening to what the two Dinghous were saying.
